qualifying_produce.sourceText:
An agricultural household for 77th Round survey was defined as a household receiving
value of produce more than Rs. 4000/- from agricultural activities (e.g., cultivation of field
crops, horticultural crops, fodder crops, plantation, animal husbandry, poultry, fishery,
piggery, bee-keeping, vermiculture, sericulture, etc.) and having at least one member self-
employed in agriculture either in the principal status or in subsidiary status during last 365
days

plates.explain: Lender shares describe outstanding loan rupees. Indebtedness counts agricultural households with loans; mean loan amount includes all agricultural households. A lender share is not the share of people borrowing from that lender.
